title: fix(plugin-email)!: an email's text, html and attachment content reach the mail transport only as a string or as bytes
body:
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no published skill or doc page teaches email attachments; `EmailAttachment` already declares `content` as `string | Buffer`, and this change makes the runtime refuse what that type excluded.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:邮件附件的 `content` 只接受字符串或 `Buffer`;其它形状(对象、流、非 Buffer 的类型化数组、null/缺失、非数组的 `attachments`、null 元素)在写投递行、调用传输之前直接拒收,REST 返回 400 `VALIDATION_FAILED`,只点名位置与类型,不回显值。插件构建的每个 SMTP 传输(启动、保存的设置、设置页测试邮件)在传输与每封邮件上固定打开 nodemailer 的 `disableFileAccess` / `disableUrlAccess`,`transportOptions` 关不掉。
- 为什么改:规则是「邮件的 text、html 与每个附件内容只以字符串或字节到达传输,传输从不代消息读服务器文件或取 URL」。之前此类附件内容会被接受并内联投递。
- 风险与回滚:收紧(BREAKING),只影响进程内传流、类型化数组或对象作附件内容的调用方,改传 `Buffer` 即可;一方生产者不传此类内容。回滚即还原 `normalizeMessage` 里一行 `assertAttachments` 调用与 `smtp.ts` 两处 `SMTP_CONTENT_ACCESS_CLOSED` 展开。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-service.ts` 的 `assertAttachments` 与 `sendInternal` 里的第二道检查;`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/transports/smtp.ts` 的 `buildSmtpOptions` 与 `send`;`packages/rest/src/email-send-display-name.test.ts` 末尾新增的 describe。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/email-send-display-name.test.ts`,预期 65 个用例全绿,其中 36 个拒收用例(12 种形状 × 持久化开/关/队列开)断言 400 + `VALIDATION_FAILED` + 传输未被调用 + 无 queued 行。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The rule: a message's text, html and every attachment's content reach the mail transport only as a string or as bytes, and the mail transport never reads a server file or fetches a URL on a message's behalf.

- **Refusal at `normalizeMessage`** (`@objectstack/plugin-email`). `attachments`, when present and not `null`, must be an array of plain objects whose `content` is a `string` or a `Buffer` (`Buffer.isBuffer`), the whole of `EmailAttachment`. Anything else is `VALIDATION_FAILED` naming the position and the kind, never the value:
  - content: `` `attachments[I].content` must be a string or a Buffer, not KIND `` (KIND is `an object`, `a stream`, `a typed array`, `an ArrayBuffer`, `null`, `undefined`, `a number`, …);
  - a non-array `attachments`: `` `attachments` must be an array, not KIND ``;
  - a `null` or non-plain element: `` `attachments[I]` must be a plain object, not KIND ``.

  It runs beside the existing `subject` / `text` / `html` type checks, so it takes the same path: before any `sys_email` delivery row or transport call, a `failed` rejection row with `attempt_count: 0`, and the REST door's existing `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` mapping. `packages/rest/src/email-routes.ts` is unchanged.
- **The transport.** `SmtpTransport` sets `disableFileAccess: true` and `disableUrlAccess: true` on the options it builds, spread after `transportOptions` so the escape hatch cannot turn them off, and on every mail object `send()` hands to `sendMail`, so the rule holds whichever transport `transportOptions` selects. Every SMTP transport the plugin builds goes through this class (boot, saved settings, `mail/test`). `describe()` reports both flags. No new option or override.
- **The `unsupported` attachment verdict.** `encodeAttachmentsForRow` still answers `unsupported` for content outside the contract, but `send` no longer delivers such a message inline. `resolveQueueForSend` lost its inline-fallback arm; `sendInternal` keeps the verdict as a stated second check that stops the send before any row, job or transport call. It is unreachable from `send` while the `normalizeMessage` refusal stands.
- Other transports' code is untouched; the refusal sits before every transport.

## Tests

- `packages/rest/src/email-send-display-name.test.ts`, new top-level describe "an attachment's content is a string or a Buffer": 12 refused shapes through `POST /api/v1/email/send`, each with persistence on, persistence off and queue delivery on (36 cases): `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, the error names the position and never the fixture's file or URL reference, a non-SMTP transport double is never called, no `queued` row, nothing published. Controls: a string attachment with a `cid` still sends (persistence on and off), and with queue delivery on it is queued with its row carrying the attachment.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-service.test.ts`: the same rule at `normalizeMessage` with in-process shapes (a real stream, a `Uint8Array`, an `ArrayBuffer`, a class-instance element, …), the accepted shapes, and `send` with persistence on and off over a non-SMTP transport.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-service.queue-delivery.test.ts`: the old pin that delivered off-contract content inline now pins the refusal (no row at `queued`, no job, no send). CONTROL: a `Buffer` attachment with a `cid` is queued and the row rebuilds it whole for delivery.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/transports/smtp.wire.test.ts`: `SmtpTransport.send()` driven directly (past the type, since `normalizeMessage` refuses first) against the fake SMTP testkit, with a temp file and a loopback listener this test owns. For attachment content that is a file reference or a URL reference, over the SMTP transport, over it with `transportOptions` setting both flags false, and over a `transportOptions` plugin transport: the send rejects, the transport reads no file and fetches no URL (nothing of either fixture in any rendered payload, zero requests at the listener). Controls: the plugin-transport leg can see attachment bytes; a `Buffer` attachment with a `cid` still arrives inline, bytes intact.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/transports/smtp.test.ts` and `email-plugin.mail-settings.test.ts`: both flags on the built options (also with `transportOptions` setting them false), on every `sendMail` mail object, in `describe()`, and on the transports built at boot, from saved settings and by `mail/test`. The existing exact-options and `describe()` pins now carry the flags. CONTROL: a body carrying `raw`, `alternatives`, `icalEvent`, `amp`, `watchHtml` and attachment-level `path` / `href` / `raw` reaches `sendMail` with none of them.

## Acceptance notes

- The non-array and element refusals use their own sentence (`` `attachments` must be an array ``, `` `attachments[I]` must be a plain object ``) rather than the content sentence, so each names the position that is wrong.
- The `email.send.async` legacy arm hands its raw payload to `sendInline`, so a queue that serialises a `Buffer` to JSON now gets this `VALIDATION_FAILED` instead of a delivery attempt.
- Ablation of each guard separately, each restored and proved byte-identical to `HEAD`: the refusal (plugin-email rebuilt and the dist marker proved absent, then present again): 17 red in plugin-email, 37 red at the REST door; the transport-level flags: 21 red; the message-level flags: 5 red.
